note: Add an entry only with a reason and the tests that pin it, and remove it as soon as those pins are updated. Entries are limited to files that never render inside the authenticated app shell.

src/app/global-error.tsx.reason: global-error replaces the root layout when it crashes, so no stylesheet or token is loaded; inline hex colors and sizes are the only way to render a readable fallback.

src/app/privacy-policy/page.tsx.reason: Serves the historical privacy policy replica verbatim from /assets/static/privacy-policy-view.html (the mobile app links to it); its embedded stylesheet and skip link follow that document, not the app design system.
